results.title: Republic FC advances to USL Championship Final after extra-time victory against New Mexico United
results.description: The Sacramento Republic FC clinched its spot in the USL Championship Final with a 2-1 victory in extra time over No. 1 seed New Mexico United on Monday night.

results.title: ‘Dreadful Officiating,’ ‘Need To Be Investigated’ — NFL Fans Rip Refs Over Controversial No-PI Call Ends Up Costing Ravens MNF Win
results.description: The Baltimore Ravens entered the game with a 4-5 record and were looking to take advantage of a struggling Los Angeles Chargers team that had lost 11 consecutive games, dating back to last season. However, the Ravens had another frustrating night on Monday, suffering a 23-20 loss to the Chargers.

results.title: Chargers finally get their first win: 'Thrilled, let's do it every week'
results.description: The Chargers beat the Ravens 23-30 on Monday night to earn their first win since Week 16 of last season, bringing a franchise-wide sigh of relief.
